title: PMCE: Probabilistic Multi-Granularity Semantics with Caption-Guided Enhancement for Few-Shot Learning
reasoning: No discussion or evaluation of religion, faith, spiritual traditions, theology, epistemology, hermeneutics, morals, or ethics as a core component of the paper. The paper addresses 'biased prototypes' in few-shot learning, which refers to statistical bias due to scarce data, not social or ethical bias related to LLMs or human values.
